evidence_quotes.O: The base can be pointed in both horizontal and vertical directions, giving you complete flexibility for composing your photos.
evidence_quotes.C: We have used the disk heavily for several months and clean it off several times a week and have had no problems with it yet.
evidence_quotes.E: With high resolution pictures, we can fit 567 pictures on the disk. That's plenty to carry us through an entire vacation--or two.
evidence_quotes.A: It looks and feels like cheap plastic, but it works as advertised, and we have had no problems with it after 6 months of use.
evidence_quotes.N: I was a bit dubious about the quick start guide, having struggled for hours with a similar Seagate device.
